title: This Show Sucks: a Sex And The City love/hate relationship
author: Comedians You Should Know
description: A podcast about the shows people love to hate. Starting with Sex And The City, we rewatch to figure out what worked and what didn't. We discuss the bad advice given, red flags and the dating expectations that shaped us. What starts as a tv criticism quickly turns into honest conversations about dating, relationships, and the lies we believed.
